text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest` because I don't have a shell in this session. I checked each fix against the tests by reading them, so please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`, where `normalize` lives.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now uses `int(year)`, which also makes `age()` work.
- **`fees.py`**: the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days (`days_late + DAILY_FEE`) instead of multiplying them. It now multiplies.
- **`members.py`**: the borrow limit was 3; the tests and the comment above it both say 5, so I changed it to 5.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned one event too many (`[-n-1:]`). It now returns the last `n` events, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added it as `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`; the tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.

I didn't change any tests.
